# Icons

18 named glyphs from the icon font in `components/bundle.css`. Never draw an SVG icon the system has.

## Use

```jsx
<TVTracker.Icon name="home" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="TVTracker.Icon" name="home"></x-import>
```

## Names

`back`, `bookmark`, `check`, `chevron`, `close`, `cloud`, `eye`, `film`, `folder`, `heart`, `home`, `more`, `play`, `plus`, `search`, `star`, `tv`, `user`
